display_long_description:
# Welcome to Critter Baboon,
a Fan-game inspired by Scary Baboon AND Lethal Ape!
- Your Support gives us more courage and determination to create more games like this, if you'd like to play please consider writing a valid rating of your opinions on it and what we can do to make it a whole lot better!

[media]
# Run, Hide, do whatever you can to survive...

[media]
# Discover secrets never shared ever before...

And most importantly, we hope you enjoy the game & have as much fun as possible!
